Label: has area
Comment: Relates an entity to an important subject area of interest

Label: Natively supports
Comment: Relates a language to a concept that it supports natively

Label: has space
Comment: Relates an entity to a technological space to which it characteristically belongs

Label: Supports
Comment: Relates a language to a concept that it supports

Label: targets
Comment: Relates a tool entity to a language entity that it targets

Label: has tool
Comment: Relates a technological space to a kind of tool that it is concerned with

Label: processes
Comment: Relates a tool entity to an artifact entity that it characteristically processes

Label: uses
Comment: Relates an ontology entity to another ontology entity that it uses conceptually, methodologically, or technically

Label: element of
Comment: Relates an artifact to a language in the set-theoretic sense

Label: has supporting language
Comment: Relates a software engineering activity to a language kind that is characteristically used to perform or express the activity

Label: Has primary component
Comment: Relates a composite language concept to a (primary) component

Label: Has secondary component
Comment: Relates a composite language concept to a (secondary) component

Label: has artifact
Comment: Relates a technological space to a kind of artifact that it is concerned with

Label: has input artifact
Comment: Relates an activity or a tool to an artifact kind that it typically requires or consumes as input

Label: has output artifact
Comment: Relates an activity or a tool to an artifact kind that it typically produces as output

Label: has supporting tool
Comment: Relates a software engineering activity to a tool kind that characteristically supports carrying out the activity

Label: Metamodeling policy
Comment: Documents ontology-wide expectations for explicit punning-based typing of classes and individuals

Label: Asserted for concept
Comment: Relates a reified assertion about language concepts with the concept

Label: Asserted for language
Comment: Relates a reified assertion about language concepts with the language

Label: Has dominant form
Comment: Relates a language concept to a dominated form

Label: Has support kind
Comment: Relates a reified assertion about language concepts with the type of support

Label: serves
Comment: Relates an entity to a methodological approach that it serves, realizes, supports, or instantiates in an important way

Label: Has primary mechanism
Comment: Relates a reified assertion about language concepts with the primary mechanism for realization

Label: has BibTeX
Comment: Relates an entity to the BibTeX key of a bibliographic entry that documents, discusses, or supports it

Label: Commenting policy
Comment: Documents the ontology-wide expectation regarding commenting

Label: Formatting policy
Comment: Documents the ontology-wide expectation regarding formatting

Label: Linking policy
Comment: Documents ontology-wide expectations for linking classes and individuals to descriptive web pages

Label: has affected artifact
Comment: Relates an activity or a tool to an artifact kind that it typically affects (thereby complementing in- and output)

Label: conforms to
Comment: Relates an artifact to another artifact in the generalized sense of models conforming to metamodels

Label: classifies
Comment: Relates an artifact to another artifact in the generalized sense of metamodels classifying models

Label: extends
Comment: Relates a software language to another software language that it extends or generalizes

Label: Standardly supports
Comment: Relates a language to a concept that it supports standardly

Label: is specified by
Comment: Relates an entity to a methodological approach used to formally specify or define its behavior or meaning

Label: defines
Comment: Relates an artifact to a language in the sense of a definition (specification)
